Subject: Delta AI — Technical deep-dive scheduling

Hi Emily / Josh —

Great to meet today — thanks for the candid conversation about your latency targets and model hosting constraints. Quick recap on next steps from our side and a proposal for a technical deep dive: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce per-call latency for real-time inference to <120ms 95th on 2k token requests.
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for PII, strict egress rules, and a small fleet of GPU hosts for pilot.
- Key stakeholders for the deep dive: your ML engineering lead (infra), SRE, and platform security.

Proposed technical deep dive
- Duration: 60–90 minutes (recommended 90)
- Attendees: Delta AI ML/Infra + SRE, Dylan (AE), Marissa (Solutions Engineer), Lukas (Inference/Infra)
- Suggested agenda:
  1) 15m — current infra & constraints (Delta)
  2) 25m — Redwood serving architecture and fit to constraints
  3) 20m — ops, security, and deployment patterns (VPC/on-prem options)
  4) 20m — Q&A / next steps / mutual action plan

Available slots (PT):
- Wed Aug 26 — 10:00–11:30am PT (preferred)
- Thu Aug 27 — 2:00–3:30pm PT
- Fri Aug 28 — 9:00–10:30am PT

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan to speed the meeting prep. Can you confirm which slot works and who from your infra team will join?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Delta AI — Technical deep-dive scheduling

Thanks everyone — adding a few technical items we'd like to include in the agenda so we can demo relevant pieces in-session:

Marissa's proposed additions (for the 90m slot):
- Live demo: inference with a 2k-token request (show end-to-end latency numbers and KV cache warm/cold behavior) — requires a sample payload and model size ahead of time.
- Quantization path: quick comparison FP16 vs 4-bit (accuracy / perf tradeoffs) and recommended profiles for 3090 vs A10G (if you can tell us hardware you plan to pilot).
- Networking & egress: proposed architecture for private deployments (VPC peering, NAT alternatives, and KMS integration for keys).
- Rollout strategy: canary + fallback to hosted variants if pilot capacity is insufficient.

Pre-reqs from Delta to make the session actionable:
1) model size (parameters) or an example model artifact OR a sample request/response so we can run the 2k token demo.
2) IP ranges / allowlist and any firewall rules we should know about.
3) preferred auth method (OIDC client id / redirect URI or mTLS cert approach) — we can demo both, but we'll prep slides.

If you can drop those in reply or in the HubSpot deal record, we'll tailor the demo. See you on Wed.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
